Table 11. CA – Vulva

 

 

 

 

 

•Incisional Biopsy: for diagnosis of malignancy.
•Excisional Biopsy: where low suspicion of invasive CA and operator wishes to limit the cosmetic harm.
•Radical Excision: At least 1cm clear margins.
•Wide/ local Excision: Margins of 15mm.
•Triple incision/ Butterfly incision:
•Ipsilateral L nodes dissection => positive on biopsy => do contralateral dissection as interval procedure
